content_data.meeting_title: Robotics Innovation Ecosystem - European Strategy Alignment
agenda_items: Identifying key technological gaps and opportunities in industrial and service robotics
Review of current EU robotics funding landscapes and strategic priorities
key_decisions: Initiate preliminary discussions with European Commission representatives regarding a dedicated funding instrument for ethical robotics development.
attendees: Professor Kai Müller (Director, Institute for Advanced Robotics, Technical University of Munich)
Dr. Ling Chen (Lead AI Scientist, KUKA Robotics Europe)
Dr. Elena Petrova (Senior Researcher, Robotics and Autonomous Systems Group, University of Cambridge)
